svg.title: BrosTrend AXE3000
svg.desc: Graphite dual-blade USB Wi-Fi adapter viewed from above. The exposed blue USB-A connector points down and left. The silver BrosTrend logo and AXE3000 specification read from the plug toward the hinges, following the perspective of the housing.

g.aria-label: AXE3000 Wi-Fi 6E Tri-Band High Gain USB Adapter
